subject.title: test(repair): add hermetic automerge end-to-end flow

question: May the automerge E2E workflow execute the externally published `masonxhuang` Docker Hub base image, or must its base image be built and attested through a repository- or organization-controlled supply chain?
rationale: A pinned digest provides immutability, but selecting an external image publisher as code executed in routine CI is a repository security-boundary decision rather than a mechanical test-harness choice.

options.title: Use a repository-controlled base
options.body: Build from `test/e2e/automerge/Dockerfile.base` in trusted CI or publish a provenance-backed organization-owned image, then pin that artifact digest in the harness.

options.title: Explicitly accept the external publisher
options.body: Document an explicit exception for this Docker Hub image and its review/provenance ownership before allowing routine CI to execute it.

recommendation.title: Use a repository-controlled base
recommendation.body: Build from `test/e2e/automerge/Dockerfile.base` in trusted CI or publish a provenance-backed organization-owned image, then pin that artifact digest in the harness.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current proposed E2E stack and can supply the implementation details while a repository security owner confirms the policy.
